answer: Accountability triads block fakes. 1) Every newcomer joins two strangers in a triad and locks a $40 bond. 2) For six weeks the triad finishes four verified paired tasks weekly, like co-signing deliveries or auditing work logs. 3) Anyone can flag a fake; if upheld, the fake loses its bond and the other two split it. 4) One sybil is a vertex in a trellis of real labor it cannot sustain, so 1,000 fakes need 2,000 accomplices risking $40 plus 144,000 hours of paired work. It holds like an ocean reef: every polyp lives only through its neighbors, and a fake polyp starves within days.
